subtitle: Running pacer in your ears
promo: Record your run and hear in your earbuds how you're doing against your own form. No account, no ads, your routes stay on your phone.
playShort: Running app that tells you in your earbuds how you're doing against your form.
iapDescription: Import run history from Strava or Garmin
locationUsage: Běhánek records the route of your run. Your location stays on your phone.
description:
Běhánek does only what you need when your running shoes are on. It records your run, shows it on a map and, while you run, tells you briefly in your earbuds how you're doing against your own form. No feed, no kudos, no badges, no training plans.

PACER: YOU RACE YOURSELF
From your recent runs of a similar length (up to ten in the last 60 days) Běhánek works out your typical pace for every kilometer. That's today's goal: just hold it, or go 2 % faster. Every 30 s, minute, two or five minutes it tells you how far you've gone and how you're doing, e.g. “three kilometers, pace five ten, five seconds faster”. An announcement takes a few seconds.

Prefer no voice? Use tones: two short = speed up, one long = slow down, silence = on target. Music in another app only gets quieter during an announcement, it never stops. The voice speaks 15 languages.

GHOST is the second mode. Pick one of your earlier runs that started within 300 m of where you're standing and race it: “140 meters ahead”.

Until you have at least three runs, the pacer doesn't make anything up and only announces time and distance.

WHILE YOU RUN
Big numbers you can read even in sunlight: time, distance, current pace (over the last ~200 m) and average. A 3-2-1 countdown gives you time to pocket the phone. You stop only with a slide, so it never ends by accident in your pocket. Then you choose: save, keep running, or discard.

Auto-pause at traffic lights and a cadence metronome (160–190 steps per minute) can be switched on in settings. One button switches to a live map of your route. Points are saved continuously, so if the app crashes, the run is saved on the next launch.

HISTORY AND RUN DETAIL
Runs are grouped by month, with distance, number of runs and whether your pace is faster than last month. Any month can become a REPORT image (km per week, pace trend, longest run) to share with anyone.

The run detail shows the route on a map with distance markers, splits (fastest split highlighted), elevation gain, a pace chart and an elevation profile. The map is outdoor (contours, trails) or satellite. You can trim the start and end if you forgot to stop.

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
Běhánek has no account, no ads and no third-party analytics. Routes stay on your phone and your location is never sent anywhere. It sends only anonymous usage statistics (which screens and features get used, never your location or routes), and you can turn them off in Settings. The app asks for location only “while using the app”, never “always”.

Every run can be EXPORTED AS GPX and all of them backed up to a ZIP. Export is always free.

IMPORT FROM STRAVA OR GARMIN
The only paid thing is IMPORTING your history: a one-time purchase, no subscription. It reads single GPX files as well as a full Strava bulk export (ZIP), so the pacer has your form to work with from your very first run. Before you pay, you can preview for free what will be imported.

Kilometers or miles, the app and the voice in 15 languages.
